title: HTTP 与应用日志总览
description: 运行 Go / Node SDK demo 后，按 service 观察请求数量与日志趋势。

variables.name: services
variables.label: 服务
variables.sql: SELECT DISTINCT service FROM metric_http_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY service

queries.sql: SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, concat(service, ' / ', name) AS series, sum(toDecimal256(value_int, 0)) AS value FROM metric_http_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND temporality='DELTA' AND service IN {services:Array(String)} GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time
SELECT severity AS category, service AS series, count() AS value FROM log_app WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND service IN {services:Array(String)} GROUP BY category, series ORDER BY category
